register.title: PingYou Ltd's refined n207 certificate at 1041863, issue503
register.headline: A tighter rational realization of PingYou Ltd's packing of 207 squares
register.source_checks: The author reports that three exact checkers, its own rational polygon-projection checker and Evan Daniel's unchanged verify_cert.py and verify_cert2.py, accept all 207 squares, 828 wall conditions and 21,321 pairs; that its package replays the recorded rational construction and owner lineage and checks the lossless conversion to its corners Witness/v2; and that this repository's sqpack exact_verify and check_rational_witness_independent, unchanged at 074ac28, accept that witness. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit PingYou Ltd (https://github.com/BuddenPing/square-packing-certificates) with the n207 assembly and this refinement of its certificate, as the source asks: two differently placed patches of Ryan Xu's n70 construction (ry-xu, issue 432), taken from Evan Daniel's exact n70 certificate, with upright grids of 42 and 36 squares. The source names SQUISH's n207 (issue 481) only as its earlier comparison. The pinned source makes no statement about AI assistance; the author's statement on issue 503 of 12 October, 'Both solutions were AI assisted by "PY", an unreleased agentic AI offering by PingYou Ltd.', covers the n207 assembly.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then decide whether it replaces T-147 at 207, which it improves by 1.49e-9: Mishapolk's #573 and #593 print smaller sides, and the author's own PR #574 states smaller ones still, so adoption waits on their imports. Final exact-head CI remains required.
